starter_files.contents:
# Asynchronous Data Processing Engine

Run with `dotnet run`. Use synthetic data first, bound concurrency, and document resource limits and cancellation behavior.

## Done when

- [ ] Stream rather than loading all input when practical
- [ ] Limit concurrent work and propagate cancellation
- [ ] Handle per-item failures without losing run-level diagnostics
- [ ] Test correctness and benchmark realistic data
